name: Smoke detector plan symbol
summary: Fire alarm plan symbol for a point smoke detector, drawn as a detector box with a smoke indication.
description: Point smoke detectors are drawn on fire alarm layouts as a square or circle with a smoke mark inside, such as wavy lines or the letter S, at their ceiling position. Each symbol is usually tagged with its loop and device address so the plan doubles as the commissioning record.

Spacing and coverage radius depend on ceiling height and the applicable fire detection code, so the plan is used to check coverage. Detectors near air supply grilles, in voids or in lift shafts need special attention and often appear with extra annotations.
The symbol does not tell you whether the detector is optical, ionisation or multi-sensor unless tagged. A separate GA object may record its physical installation point.
readingNotes: Read the loop and address tag.
drawingChecklist: Note void or concealed locations needing indicators.
distinction: A heat detector responds to temperature, not smoke; it uses a different internal mark.
